channel.title: Business Insider France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider France (businessinsider.fr)

item.title: Elon Musk says Tesla is discontinuing Model S and Model X and doubling down on Optimus robots
item.description: Tesla CEO Elon Musk said the EV maker will discontinue the Model S and X, Tesla's premium sedan and SUV offerings, in the next quarter.

item.title: Tesla Q4 earnings recap: Musk talks $2 billion xAI investment, Optimus 3 — and makes shock announcement
item.description: Tesla's earnings beat Wall Street's estimates, with the stock rising after hours. Elon Musk saved the biggest news for Tesla's analyst call

item.title: Meta and Microsoft both blew their data center budgets last quarter. Wall Street is only mad at one of them.
item.description: The Big Tech rivals are spending more than ever, but analysts are more concerned about Microsoft at the moment.

item.title: Microsoft says OpenAI is driving 45% of the backlog for Azure cloud computing
item.description: OpenAI and Microsoft have a reconfigured relationship. The software giant revealed just how much OpenAI is driving its RPO.

item.title: Emma Heming Willis says Bruce Willis not knowing he has dementia has been both 'the blessing and the curse'
item.description: "It is also hard to grieve someone who is still alive. You know, it's not natural," Emma Heming Willis said.

item.title: Tesla takes another leap toward becoming a physical AI company: Here are the 6 biggest takeaways from its Q4 earnings call.
item.description: Tesla CEO Elon Musk announced a $2B investment into xAI and the discontinuation of Model S and Model X in order to support Optimus robot production.

item.title: I visited every country by 25. These are 3 cities I always recommend — and one I'd skip.
item.description: In college, Cameron Mofid set out on a mission to visit every country — not just as a travel goal, but as a way to confront his obsessive-compulsive disorder.

item.title: OpenAI's chair says vibe coding is here to stay — but it's not the endgame
item.description: Vibe coding will stick around, but AI agents, not apps, will drive the next big shift in software, says OpenAI's chair Bret Taylor.

item.title: Russia's fiercest offensive last year still moved slower than WWI's Battle of the Somme, analysts say
item.description: Moscow says it's been gaining momentum, but the researchers said even its advance in Pokrovsk was slower than the Allies' in the Battle of the Somme.

item.title: Sergey Brin and the who's who of the tech scene just spent millions in donations ahead of California's wealth tax vote
item.description: Sergey Brin, Max Levchin, Eric Schmidt, and others donated $35 million to ballot measure committees in January.
